summary: Curbline Properties Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a forward sale of 10 million common shares (plus a 1.5 million share over-allotment) via an underwritten public offering under an existing shelf registration. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special-situation event such as a going-private, tender, or restructuring. The company entered into forward sale agreements with Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and Wells Fargo, expecting to deliver shares within 18 months for general corporate purposes including acquisitions and debt repayment. No premium, break fee, or board recommendation is involved; this is a standard equity offering.
